findings.issue: וְאֶת marks the ram as object of 3ms piel נִתַּח; לִנְתָחָיו is into its pieces. Spanish makes the ram the agent and the pieces the thing cut.
findings.spanishSpan: el carnero descuartizó a sus cuartos

findings.issue: The plural pieces have no count of four; cuartos can mean fourths.

notes: The Moses clause matches hiphil וַיַּקְטֵר and the three objects head, pieces, and suet.
